svg.text: 2 protein models (2 curated) · 597 alignment columns · MAFFT · primary NP_035332.1 / NM_011202.3
Where along the alignment do the protein isoforms of this gene differ from the primary protein?
Major variable blocks: 1 · major gap blocks: 1 · 4 variable and 4 gap-containing columns of 597.
Conservation is the fraction of the shown models carrying the column's most frequent residue, so a gapped column scores low.
One plotted mark spans 2 alignment columns at this width; a difference or gap mark is drawn where any column within it qualifies.
Filled marker: curated model · open marker: predicted model · identity: percentage of aligned residue pairs identical to the primary protein.
Exploratory analysis; no isoform difference shown here is a validated splicing event.
